svg.aria-label: Compressed elliptic level sets and exact Dirichlet profiles
svg.text: An elliptic boundary point still needs its boundary condition
t = nx; tangential factor eⁱⁿᶻ suppressed
Zero value removes the normal endpoint term.
Equations DE27–DE30 give the exact energies.
Left: symbol level sets, not rays. Right: normalized profiles from the solved exercises.
